rows.question: Do mRNA vaccines change your DNA?
rows.claim: The Covid vaccine is an RNA vaccine. This will actually change your DNA.
rows.rating: Some of the Covid-19 vaccine candidates are RNA vaccines. These don’t alter your DNA, they comprise of mRNA that gives the body instructions on how to make the proteins on the surface of the virus.

rows.question: Does sunscreen cause cancer?
rows.claim: Using sunscreen raises the risk of skin cancer.
rows.rating: No it doesn’t. Sunscreen lowers the risk of skin cancer. But people who use more of it may well be exposed to more sunlight too.

rows.question: Did Bill Gates patent the coronavirus?
rows.claim: A patent for coronavirus was granted in 2018 to the Pirbright Institute UK, founded by Bill and Melinda Gates.
rows.rating: A patent for a different virus in the same family as the Wuhan virus was applied for by the Pirbright Institute, which receives part of its funding from the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

rows.question: Are humans causing climate change?

rows.question: Are sea levels rising?
rows.claim: Sea levels aren't rising.
rows.rating: False. Sea levels have risen 15-25cm since 1901.

rows.question: Is Arctic sea ice shrinking?
rows.claim: On average, the area of Arctic sea ice during summer and winter has never changed.
rows.rating: False. Satellite data shows the extent of Arctic sea ice has been steadily shrinking in both winter and summer for nearly 50 years.

rows.question: Is Greenland's ice sheet melting?

rows.question: Is Antarctica losing ice?
